author: PlayStation
description:
Embark on a hilariously chaotic 8-bit action-adventure as Sir Solomon, a lovestruck knight determined to rescue Princess Tsuna and win her heart. Slice through monsters, tackle over 50 levels, and navigate over 150 randomized event scenes where anything can happen—from RPG battles to world-ending surprises. Collect quirky items, shop for upgrades, and meet a cast of over 100 eccentric characters, including designs by renowned manga artist Ryusuke Mita. With a catchy chiptune soundtrack and pixel art by lead designer Matt Kap, conquer the Devil Lord’s castle one unpredictable room at a time in this wacky, heart-driven quest!

Coming to PS5 February 5, 2026!

CASSETTE BOY presents a highly complex pixel-art world, where what first appears to be a two-dimensional graphic is, in fact, a three-dimensional space. You can rotate it to change what is visible from the hero’s perspective and what disappears.
 
To solve puzzles, you must rotate and tilt the map, shifting your point of view. By using the game’s mechanics, you can make obstacles vanish from sight or uncover secrets and hidden passages.

description:
All Trails lead here! The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon is now available for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5.

Van Arkride and the members of Arkride Solutions are back, and this time the future of the entire Zemurian continent is at stake! But they won't be the only ones facing the secrets at the very core of Zemuria: Father Kevin Graham from the Trails in the Sky series and Rean Schwarzer of Trails of Cold Steel will both become entangled in the latest events. 

Enjoy evolved gameplay, including new mechanics such as Shard Commands, Awakening, and the time-freezing Z.O.C., giving you unparalleled control in both Field and Command Battles! Then, take a custom team of your favorite characters into the Grim Garten to put a stop to Ouroboros' machinations!

The latest title in this legendary RPG franchise is finally here!
